name: TSAR-2022 Shared Task on Multilingual Lexical Simplification
description: We report findings of the TSAR-2022 shared task on multilingual lexical simplification, organized as part of the Workshop on Text Simplification, Accessibility, and Readability TSAR-2022 held in conjunction with EMNLP 2022. The task called the Natural Language Processing research community to contribute with methods to advance the state of the art in multilingual lexical simplification for English, Portuguese, and Spanish. A total of 14 teams submitted the results of their lexical simplification systems for the provided test data. Results of the shared task indicate new benchmarks in Lexical Simplification with English lexical simplification quantitative results noticeably higher than those obtained for Spanish and (Brazilian) Portuguese.
evaluation_method: Accuracy@1 (Acc@1) and related metrics such as Potential@K, MAP, precision/recall
typical_sota_score: 60–85% (language-dependent; English scores generally higher than Spanish/Portuguese)
reputation: Recognized EMNLP shared task for multilingual lexical simplification that set new baselines and attracted moderate community participation.
notes: Multilingual dataset with moderate size; evaluation depends on lexical resources and candidate generation; potential contamination for large pre-trained LMs; not saturated.
